model: IFM/Jais-ASR-MLX-4bit (revision 0867c7a: 4-bit GPTQ text decoder, bf16 audio encoder), local on Apple M5 16 GB through mlx-vlm 6ecadd7 + IFM mlx-vlm-jais-asr.patch, MLX 0.32.4

settings.languagePin: same as the clip language (ar or en), the --language option
settings.prompt: empty user prompt, default chat template (as the card CLI example)
settings.decoding: greedy (temperature 0), repetition penalty 1.05, at most 256 tokens
settings.speechGate: none; raw clip sent, the model has its own no-speech signal ([IFM-NoTranscript])

ar.note: this process only; resumed runs report the last process

en.note: this process only; resumed runs report the last process

withTemplates.description: Per clip, the template step of scripts/template-bench.ts (unionWithWhisper, own closed set: digits 0-9 for digit clips, yes/no for yes/no clips; one other repeat by the same speaker per word; strict thresholds) with the same seeds, so the template draws match the published run. X or templates = X correct, or the templates accept the right word. Template false credit = the templates accept a wrong word. Same-session read repeats; in the real check the templates would come from the registration trial.
